# Minus33

> > Minus33 manufactures premium merino wool and Woolverino thermal clothing and base layers for outdoor enthusiasts, based in New Hampshire with a heritage in American textile craftsmanship.

Minus33 specializes in performance merino wool apparel across multiple weight classes (Microweight 145, Midweight 245, Heavyweight 400) for hiking, hunting, fishing, cycling, and expedition activities. Their product lines include the Chocorua, Franconia, Isolation, Kenai, and Kodiak collections, plus USA-made Mountain Heritage wool socks.

## Key Topics

- Merino Wool
- Woolverino (merino-synthetic blend)
- Base Layers & Thermal Clothing
- Microweight 145 (lightweight performance)
- Midweight 245 (all-season versatility)
- Heavyweight 400 (expedition warmth)
- Chocorua Collection
- Franconia Collection
- Mountain Heritage Socks
- UPF Sun Protection
- New Hampshire Manufacturing
- Outdoor & Athletic Apparel
- Cold Weather Accessories
- Hunting & Fishing Gear
- ExpertVoice Pro Program
